item: Layout budget, Phase 2a: the guide pages in one screen, the start page, and Title Case action labels
spec: docs/revamp/specs/layout-budget.md; owner rule of 5 Nov (Title Case for English button, button-styled link and menu item labels)
changed: apps/web/components/public-page.tsx, public-page.css, page-compact.css: one shared template for /sell /source /trade-missions /enter-market /machinery /business-trips /institutions /network /trust. Compact hero and steps, and the closing sections sit in a native details element (Show More) with all content in the server HTML.
apps/web/app/workspace/page.tsx, workspace.css: the start page fits one screen on desktop; the sign-in routes are a details on a phone and open in three columns on desktop.

Title Case on action labels (text changed, no CSS text-transform): public pages and their catalogues, the /plan form catalogue, the home and discovery controls, the privacy toggle, the buyer pages, and every button in the organiser room (apps/web/app/account/delegations). The header buttons in corner-dock.tsx and messages.ts follow the same rule.
preserved: Every link, id, name, payload and test hook kept; hidden content stays in the server HTML and an old #page-next address opens it.
P-06 old-address tests, P-11 payload and the ux-plan-languages request bodies unchanged; that test's English baseline moved to the commit that carries the Title Case labels, on purpose.

Left in sentence case on purpose: sign-in, sign-up, password and verify-email pages (Guardian review), shared components owned by S2 and S4, plain text links, headings, form option labels, other languages.
